test_title: PYST 74: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Deepak is studying B.tech. at IIT Delhi to become the engineer.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In English, when referring to a generic profession, we do not use the definite article "the."
 
• The correct phrase should be "to become an engineer," not "the engineer."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Deepak is studying B.tech. at IIT Delhi to become an engineer."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "B.tech. at IIT Delhi"** – This part is correct; it specifies what and where Deepak is studying.
 
• **Option 3: "to become"** – This part is correct; it accurately describes the purpose of his studies.
 
• **Option 4: "Deepak is studying"** – This part is correct; it is the main clause of the sentence.
